domainhints: CCA Line of Business added to the existing CSSHealth / ClarestHealth OUTBOUND 834 trading partner. Flow is proprietary-file driven: Enrollment IT drops a proprietary MADUAL extract, Edifecs ST maps it through the ClarestHealth Map and generates the outbound EDI 834 enrollment file, which is SNIP validated and delivered for TESTING ONLY. There is no inbound file and no member load into Facets in this story; Facets is read-only here, used only to source the 9-digit SBSB ID. MADUAL and CCA are NOT interchangeable: CCA is the Line of Business being added, MADUAL is the population/file-scope token that appears in file names. SEGMENT GLOSSARY (authoritative): Maintenance Reason Code = Loop 2000 INS04, sourced from the MAINTENANCE_CODE field in the proprietary file. Deceased Date = Loop 2000 INS12, sourced from Death_Date in the proprietary file. Member ID = Loop 2000 REF*0F (qualifier 0F). MTM opt-out = Loop 2750, written as LX~ then N1*75*MTM_OPT_OUT~ then REF*ZZ* carrying the indicator value; production sample is LX*3~ N1*75*MTM_OPT_OUT~ REF*ZZ*N~. Always name an element by its business term plus its loop and qualifier notation (Loop 2000 INS04, Loop 2000 REF*0F, Loop 2750 N1*75); never name one by a bare element position such as INS01, INS02, INS03, DTP01, N101 or LX01. FILE NAMING (authoritative; AC-6 supersedes the Description): outbound files are CS_MADUAL_CLAREST_P_INCR_834_YYYYMMDDhhmmss.edi for the daily Change/Incremental file and CS_MADUAL_CLAREST_P_FULL_834_YYYYMMDDhhmmss.edi for the monthly Full file, where the fifth token is the environment indicator - P for production, T for test - so a CRT execution asserts T and P only when the case explicitly validates the production naming. The MADUAL token is mandatory; the Description's CS_CLAREST_P_INCR_834 / CS_CLAREST_P_FULL_834 forms are superseded and must never be emitted. The pre-change legacy names CARESOURCE_CSSHEALTH_P_INCR_834_<timestamp>.<GUID>.edi and CARESOURCE_CSSHEALTH_P_FULL_834_<timestamp>.<GUID>.edi are the OLD standard and must never be emitted as the expected name; the GUID suffix is not part of the new standard. Proprietary INPUT files are MADUAL_CSSHealth_C_CCYYMMDDHHSS.txt (Change) and MADUAL_CSSHealth_F_CCYYMMDDHHSS.txt (Full), picked up by the Tidal job using the file masks MADUAL_CSSHealth_C* and MADUAL_CSSHealth_F*. LOCATIONS (authoritative): proprietary extract source is \\daycrtappfs01\crt_applications\Applications\VendorExtractUtility\CSSHealth in CRT (the environment token in the story's path is resolved, never left as a placeholder). Generated test files are delivered to \\daycrtappfs01\Projects\CSSHEALTH\From_CareSource. BUSINESS RULES (authoritative): Plan Year 2026 Member ID logic - migrated members carry a 10-digit CCA-assigned Member ID in Loop 2000 REF*0F, net-new members carry an 11-digit CareSource Member ID formed as the 9-digit Facets subscriber id (CMC_SBSB_SUBSC.SBSB_ID) with a literal 00 suffix; digit length is the discriminator and must be asserted explicitly. INS04 is populated from MAINTENANCE_CODE and must align with current CCA disenrollment rules. INS12 is populated ONLY when Death_Date is non-null and must be absent when Death_Date is null. Loop 2750 is created ONLY when MTM_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR carries a value and must be absent entirely when the field is blank. Both a Full and a Change/Incremental outbound file are produced as applicable, from separate proprietary inputs. Every generated file must pass SNIP 1 and SNIP 2 validation; SNIP levels 3 and above are out of scope. All segments must comply with the approved 834 Proprietary-to-EDI map instance. OUT OF SCOPE - never assert, populate or validate these: SSBCI_IND, SSBCI_START_DT, SSBCI_END_DT, and any deeming indicator or deeming date; they are explicitly not sent. Only the CCA Line of Business is in scope, so no other LOB population may appear in the generated file, and there is no production enablement - delivery is for vendor testing and review only. COVERAGE follows the story's own acceptance criteria: separate Change and Full proprietary intake by file mask and pickup by the ClarestHealth Map, outbound file naming for both Change and Full, map compliance across all segments, SNIP 1 and SNIP 2 pass, REF*0F for a migrated member and REF*0F for a net-new member as two separate conditions, INS04 populated from MAINTENANCE_CODE, INS12 populated when Death_Date is present and absent when it is null, Loop 2750 created when MTM_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR is present and absent when it is blank, and delivery of the generated test files to the CSSHealth From_CareSource location. Absence conditions (INS12 not populated, Loop 2750 not created, SSBCI and deeming elements not sent) carry MORE validation steps, not fewer: assert the element is absent from the generated file, not merely that the file processed. Every test case walks the flow with resolved literal values - proprietary file with its resolved literal name placed in the resolved source path, Tidal mask pickup, Edifecs ST processing, TM UI verification with its status values, outbound file generated with its resolved literal name, SNIP result, segment-level assertion, and delivery location - with no unresolved environment, path, or file-name token anywhere.
